commits.message: Reply to GPT rounds 13-14: every verifiable claim reproduced (float tie-break bug in six selection scripts, Qwen MD-288 L35->L34 and the 288-pair DAS J advantage now [0, +0.065]; DAS loader defects D1-D5; literature errata RAVEL/ReFT/ITI/Knob; four errors in 06; check-script gaps; 7/19 no-comment pairs); new measurement: baseline drift is bf16 output quantisation (Qwen margins all on a 0.25-nat grid, Llama half on 0.125) = the real magnitude behind M5; fixes: exact-integer selection key in e23_knob_sweep/compare/2x2/read_write/est_size/merge with None when nothing is feasible and a hard fail for DAS under --plan-split, loader D1-D5 + teacher cache keyed by T (single-seed path bitwise unchanged), review checks with exit codes and full mask coverage plus chk_das_loader; corrected est-size reports kept beside the originals; docs 01/05/06/summary corrected; 07 = verification, done list, three reservations (Gemma per the owner, route A v1 lacks an interchange-vs-amplify control, M5 as a pre-registered fp32 readout), seven unanswered questions, six-step division of labour; code written by Claude, red-teamed, awaiting GPT review

Owner decisions on the round 13-14 reply (07 section 6-7): route A v1 qa_das_ptrue_ce_bidir_v1 approved for GPT to implement; Gemma enters the main line (reservation withdrawn; 4B proposed as third model, 12B diagnostics kept as failure analysis, GPT to confirm); the tie-corrected Qwen result is read as positive for the paper (96 pairs already show the DAS advantage, more data adds nothing: data efficiency), recorded verbatim in 01, 06 and the round-5 summary with the evidence stated unchanged; the real-answer-rate constraint explained and awaiting one-word confirmation; GPT asked to neutralise three wordings in review_20261104_13 and to review claims, logic and code together next round

Owner decisions, part 2: the real-answer-rate constraint for E is adopted (self-report Yes/No kept as a diagnostic; GPT to fix the measurement, budget and report template in v1); the request to neutralise three wordings in review_20261104_13 is withdrawn: the repository rule is that the advisor's name must never appear, the word itself is fine
